name: wilanis-js
description: Declarative dataflow graphs, judged by a compiler and run by a stateless engine. The @wilanis/* workspace.
author: Rafael Fontes <rfontes1987@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run build && tsc -p fitness && vitest run
scripts.check:example: npm run build && wilanis check example
scripts.rehearse:example: npm run build && wilanis rehearse example
scripts.release: git describe --tags --exact-match --match schemas-v1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'release refused: 1.0 is published only from the commit tagged schemas-v1, once no accepted RFC still changes a schema (docs/roadmap.md, RFC 0008)'; exit 1; }; npm test && npm publish -w packages/engine -w packages/core -w packages/compiler -w packages/runtime -w packages/plugin-http -w packages/plugin-blob -w packages/plugin-reload -w packages/plugin-auth -w packages/plugin-storage -w packages/plugin-storage-memory -w packages/plugin-storage-postgres -w libraries/access -w packages/view
